title: Rig Relay Product Front Door v1
site_title: Rig Relay — Governed Operating Layer for AI-Assisted Development
site_description: AI agents can change code faster than people can inspect what happened. Rig Relay makes agent work observable, controlled, and reviewable.

hero.headline: Govern Your Coding Agents. Keep the Receipts.
hero.subhead: An authority spine and evidence substrate that makes every agent decision observable, controlled, and reviewable — local-first, receipt-backed, schema-governed.

problem.headline: Coding Agents Need Governance
problem.body: Modern AI coding agents change code at speeds that outpace human review. Without governance, every agent call is an untraceable mutation. Most AI tools give agents access to your filesystem, your Git history, your package manager, and your development environment — with no audit trail, no permission gates, and no way to replay what happened. Rig Relay gives you the authority spine and evidence substrate to govern agent work with the same discipline you apply to your own code.

pillars.title: Agent Governance
pillars.body: Every agent action gated. Permission tiers (ALWAYS/ASK/NEVER), council consultation before mutations, patch gating, dirty-file preservation. Not advisory — enforced.

pillars.title: Cross-Surface Authority Spine
pillars.body: One governance model for every surface. Cockpit, CLI, MCP, ACP, WebSocket — all governed by the same spine. No surface is exempt. Every mutation requires evidence.

pillars.title: Receipt-Backed Evidence
pillars.body: Every tool call, checkpoint, and governance decision produces a schema-governed ReceiptEnvelope. Merkle-linked. Content-light. DuckDB-queryable. JSON/JSONL/CSV source-of-truth.

pillars.title: Hardened MCP Surface
pillars.body: 16 read-only tools, 6 resources, 3 prompts. Descriptor integrity, roots boundary, content-light scanning, receipt persistence, local session auth, tier authorization. 94/94 gate tests pass. No mutation tools exposed.

pillars.title: CLI Mutation Gates
pillars.body: Scripts are governed too. Every mutating command defaults to dry-run or requires --execute with approval receipt. 59/59 tests pass.

pillars.title: GitHub Operating Picture
pillars.body: Code scanning alert integration, live PR rehearsal, security lifecycle, permission posture documented. Trust Spine roadmap for cryptographic mutation enforcement.

pillars.title: Query Your Governance Data
pillars.body: DuckDB read-side analytics over JSONL evidence. Governance decisions projection. Postgres enterprise substrate planned.

pillars.title: Roadmap Steward
pillars.body: Read-only coordination agent. Ranks work slices. Detects lane collisions. Produces bounded prompts for worker agents. Never mutates. Never self-approves.

trust_pipeline.copy: Agent proposes action via cockpit, CLI, or MCP. Intent is captured as a structured request.
GovernanceRuntime evaluates against session rules and authority spine tier.
Context assembly with trust tier labeling. Content SHA256-hashed.
Execution behind runtime boundary. Environment scrubbing, bash pattern detection.
ReceiptEnvelope produced for every tool call and governance decision.
Targeted release gates verify hardening. MCP: 94/94. CLI: 59/59.
DuckDB read-side analytics. Postgres enterprise substrate planned.

enterprise_posture.headline: Honest About Maturity
enterprise_posture.body: Rig Relay is in alpha (v0.1.0a1). We document exactly what is ready and what is not. 7 P0 procurement blockers remain. No SOC 2, ISO 27001, or GDPR compliance claims. Enterprise procurement readiness audit available.
